title: Darby O'Gill and the Little People
plot: A wily old codger matches wits with the King of the Leprechauns and helps play matchmaker for his daughter and the strapping lad who has replaced him as caretaker.
writer: Lawrence Edward Watkin, H.T. Kavanagh (suggested by "Darby O'Gill" stories)
actors: Albert Sharpe, Janet Munro, Sean Connery, Jimmy O'Dea

title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
plot: An Edinburgh professor and assorted colleagues follow an explorer's trail down an extinct Icelandic volcano to the earth's center.
writer: Walter Reisch (screenplay), Charles Brackett (screenplay), Jules Verne (novel)
actors: Pat Boone, James Mason, Arlene Dahl, Diane Baker
awards: Nominated for 3 Oscars. Another 1 win & 2 nominations.

title: Sleeping Beauty
plot: After being snubbed by the royal family, a malevolent fairy places a curse on a princess which only a prince can break, along with the help of three good fairies.
director: Clyde Geronimi, Les Clark, Hamilton Luske, Wolfgang Reitherman
writer: Erdman Penner (story adaptation), Charles Perrault (story "Sleeping Beauty"), Joe Rinaldi (additional story), Winston Hibler (additional story), Bill Peet (additional story), Ted Sears (additional story), Ralph Wright (additional story), Milt Banta (additional story)
actors: Mary Costa, Bill Shirley, Eleanor Audley, Verna Felton
awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. Another 4 wins & 5 nominations.

title: The Shaggy Dog
plot: A teenage boy is cursed with periodically turning into an sheepdog.
writer: Bill Walsh (screenplay), Lillie Hayward (screenplay), Felix Salten (novel)
actors: Fred MacMurray, Jean Hagen, Tommy Kirk, Annette Funicello
